title: Russia energy reintegration optionality enters Ukraine diplomacy
net_new_delta: Reuters reported on October 3, citing the New York Times, that U.S.-Russia Ukraine negotiations include a proposed multibillion-dollar transaction involving Lukoil international oil fields, refineries and fuel-station assets. GitHub-native durable state contains no prior RUSSIA_ENERGY_REINTEGRATION_OPTIONALITY event. The proposal is material as a contingent sanctions/energy branch, but does not establish sanctions relief, transaction approval, additional supply, or changed physical flows.
